prompt: I need a Defender XDR custom detection rule that fires when a process that has never been seen accessing lsass.exe anywhere in our fleet before does so. It should run hourly. Save the KQL as detection.kql and write a short rule document (rule.md) that a reviewer could use: what it detects, MITRE mapping, the tuning knobs, known false positives, and what it would miss.
assertions: detection.kql projects Timestamp, ReportId and DeviceId in its final output (XDR required columns), recovered via arg_max/arg_min after any summarize
detection.kql computes the 'seen before' baseline from a window that ends before the recent window starts (a guard gap such as between(ago(30d)..ago(1d)) vs > ago(1d)), not an overlapping window
Every join in detection.kql states an explicit kind= (or the comparison uses !in / leftanti anti-join); there is no bare join

detection.kql does not restrict the recent-window rows with a Timestamp filter of 4h or less (XDR evaluates the lookback on ingestion_time); any explicit Timestamp bound applies only to the baseline half

lsass.exe and other file-name comparisons in detection.kql are case-insensitive (=~, in~, has) and the first-seen key includes a process identity stronger than the display name alone (SHA1/SHA256/signer or FolderPath)
Tunables (baseline length, gap, any threshold) are declared in let statements at the top of detection.kql rather than inline literals
rule.md maps the detection to MITRE ATT&CK T1003.001 (OS Credential Dumping: LSASS Memory)

rule.md names at least one concrete blind spot or evasion (e.g. parent-PID spoofing, a tool seen once during the baseline, baseline poisoning, slow attacker) and at least one named benign source of lsass access (AV/EDR, backup, monitoring agents)
The baseline window ends a stated guard margin before the recent window begins (e.g. baseline ends at ago(lookback + margin)), not merely at the adjacent 4 h boundary
rule.md describes the hourly rule's lookback as evaluated on ingestion time and does not claim that only events with Timestamp in the last 4 h are evaluated
